ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface area; high-intensity (white/gray) pixels account for approximately 5-10% of total visible ventral surface, concentrated in localized clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dark base field. Discrete, high-contrast white-outlined circular blobs are mapped in the mid-upper region of the left lobe (cluster of approx. 5 units) and the upper-lateral region of the right lobe (cluster of approx. 4 units).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 75 degrees and a bounding-box depth occupying roughly 20% of the fluke's vertical height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous boundary displays mid-frequency serration; distinct peaks and valleys are most prominent on the inner margins of both lobes, transitioning to smoother topography near the lateral tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a complex curve transitioning from concave near the median notch to convex toward the lateral terminals; leading edges are broadly convex.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of high-contrast circular pixel clusters. Left lobe: tight constellation of 5-6 interconnected white rings with dark centers. Right lobe: smaller cluster of 3-4 high-contrast circular marks.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned white linear pixel disruptions (rake-like marks) are visible vertically across the mid-section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Symmetric circular scarring clusters on the distal regions of both lobes; minor irregular notch on the trailing edge of the left lobe near the mid-point.
